attrs.name: Point in Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the point of time when the value is taken, e.g., to store an event time stamp.

attrs.name: Response Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the response time, e.g., to store the response time of operation calls.

attrs.name: Response Time Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, response time)-tuple, i.e., end of the operation call plus the response time.

attrs.name: Holding Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the holding time at a resource, e.g., to store the time spend in passive resource pools.

attrs.name: Holding Time Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, holding time)-tuple, i.e., start of the holding plus the holding time.

attrs.name: Waiting Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the waiting time, e.g., to store the waiting time at passive resource pools.

attrs.name: Waiting Time Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, waiting time)-tuple, i.e., start of the waiting plus the waiting time.

attrs.name: Resource Demand
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the CPU/HDD/DELAY/... demand of the entity, e.g., to store CPU demand measurements.

attrs.name: Resource Demand Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (resource demand, point in time)-tuple, i.e., the resource demand plus the time when it was issued.

attrs.name: State of Active Resource
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the state of an active resource, e.g., to store the number of jobs waiting at an active resource starting from a given point.

attrs.name: State of Active Resource Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, state of active resource)-tuple, i.e., the state of an active resource plus the time when the state was taken.

attrs.name: Overall State of Active Resource
attrs.textualDescription: Overall state of an active resource, starting from a given point in time. For example, this metric allows to store the utilization of a CPU over the complete simulation time.

attrs.name: State of Active Resource over Time
attrs.textualDescription: State of an active resource over time, e.g., to store the number of elements in the CPU queue over time.

attrs.name: State of Passive Resource
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the number of free tokens in a passive resource, e.g., in a connection pool.

attrs.name: State of Passive Resource Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, state of passive resource)-tuple, i.e., the state of a passive resource plus the time when the state was taken.

attrs.name: Overall State of Passive Resource
attrs.textualDescription: Overall state of a passive resource, starting from a given point in time. For example, this metric allows to store the number of connections of a connection pool over the complete simulation time.

attrs.name: State of Passive Resource over Time
attrs.textualDescription: State of a passive resource over time, e.g., to store the number of connections in a connection pool over time.

attrs.name: Execution Result
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies an execution results metric, e.g., to store simulated failure occurrences.

attrs.name: Execution Result Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (execution result, point in time)-tuple, i.e., time of getting the execution result plus the execution result itself.

attrs.name: Scalability Range
attrs.textualDescription: Scalability range without violating SLOs, e.g., the system scales up to 1,000 users.

attrs.name: Slope
attrs.textualDescription: The slope for increase rates, e.g., an increase rate of 10 users/hour.

attrs.name: Scalability Speed
attrs.textualDescription: Scalability speed without violating SLOs, e.g., the system scales up to 1,000 users with increase rate 10 users/hour.

attrs.name: User Capacity
attrs.textualDescription: Maximal number of users for fixed resource without violating SLOs, e.g., a system scales up to 1,000 users for a fixed set of resources.

attrs.name: User Capacity Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: FIXME Artificial Metric (MetricSets are required for current UI support; generally we are just interested in a user capacity number).

attrs.name: Interarrival Time Capacity
attrs.textualDescription: Maximal interarrival time for fixed resource without violating SLOs, e.g., a system scales up to 100 users per second for a fixed set of resources.

attrs.name: Interarrival Time Capacity Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: FIXME Artificial Metric (MetricSets are required for current UI support; generally we are just interested in a interarrival time capacity number).

attrs.name: Number of SLO Violations
attrs.textualDescription: The number of SLO violations in a certain time frame, e.g., 42 SLO (response time) violations in 1 hour.

attrs.name: Number of SLO Violations over Time
attrs.textualDescription: The number of SLO violations counted over time, e.g., 42 SLO (response time) violations after 1 simulated hour.

attrs.name: Mean Time to Quality Repair
attrs.textualDescription: The mean time to stop violating SLOs, e.g., 30 seconds for an additional 10 requests/hour.

attrs.name: Resource Provisioning Efficiency
attrs.textualDescription: Efficiency of provisioning resources, e.g., 10% more resources than actual resource demand.

attrs.name: Marginal Cost
attrs.textualDescription: Marginal cost for serving additional load, e.g., $1.00 for an additional 100 requests/hour.

attrs.name: Utilization of Active Resource
attrs.textualDescription: This measure stores a real number between 0 and 1 to indicate a utilization ratio at a certain point in time.

attrs.name: Utilization of Active Resource Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, utilization)-tuple, i.e., the utilization of an active resource during the interval ending at the specified point in time

attrs.name: Power Consumption
attrs.textualDescription: This measure stores a nonnegative real value denoting a power consumption.

attrs.name: Power Consumption Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, power consumption)-tuple, i.e., the power consumption during the interval ending at the specified point in time.

attrs.name: Energy Consumption
attrs.textualDescription: This measure stores a nonnegative real value denoting an energy consumption measured in kWh.

attrs.name: Cumulative Energy Consumption Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, energy consumption)-tuple, i.e., the total energy consumption until the interval ending at the specified point in time.

attrs.name: Number of Resource Containers
attrs.textualDescription: The number of resource containers present within a resource environment, e.g., 3 resource containers for a 3-tier resource environment.

attrs.name: Number of Resource Containers over Time
attrs.textualDescription: The number of resource containers over time, e.g., 5 resource containers after a scaling-out.

attrs.name: Cost over Time
attrs.textualDescription: Represents the operational cost over time, according to the usage of resource containers.

attrs.name: Aggregated Cost over Time
attrs.textualDescription: Represents the aggregated cost over time, i.e. the sum of all costs incurred from the start point to the current point in time.

attrs.name: Cost per Resource Container
attrs.textualDescription: Represents the cost of a single resource container, e.g., 10 EUR for a Server with 1 CPU

attrs.name: Cost of Resource Containers
attrs.textualDescription: Reflects the total cost of a set of resource containers

attrs.name: Reconfiguration Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the reconfiguration time, i.e., time that passes between the a system state A and a system state B

attrs.name: Reconfiguration Time Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, reconfiguration time)-tuple, i.e., start of the reconfiguration plus the reconfiguration time.

attrs.name: Optimisation Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents the execution time of an algorithm that made a reconfiguration plan

attrs.name: Optimisation Time Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Specifies a (point in time, optimisation time)-tuple, i.e., the point at which an optimisation algorithm was triggered to execute and its execution time.

attrs.name: External Event Time
attrs.textualDescription: This measure represents simulation times at which an external event is triggered

attrs.name: Number of Concurrently Executing Invocations
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for an operation the number of users that are concurrently executing the operation

attrs.name: Number of Concurrently Executing Invocations Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for an operation the number of users that are concurrently executing the operation together with the simulation point in time of the measurement

attrs.name: Request Arrival Rate
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for entities the arrival rate of requests (e.g. the rate of invocations of a provided operation)

attrs.name: Request Arrival Rate Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for entities the arrival rate of requests together with the point in simulation time the measurement was taken.

attrs.name: Response Arrival Rate
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for entities the arrival rate of responses (e.g. the rate of a provided operation finishing the execution of a request).

attrs.name: Response Arrival Rate Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: This metric captures for entities the arrival rate of responses (e.g. the rate of a provided operation finishing the execution of a request) together with the point in simulation time the measurement was taken.

attrs.name: Read Data Rate
attrs.textualDescription: Quantifies a read data rate, e.g. Bytes read per second

attrs.name: Read Data Rate Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Read Data Rate over Time

attrs.name: Write Data Rate
attrs.textualDescription: Quantifies a write data rate, e.g. Bytes written per second

attrs.name: Write Data Rate Tuple
attrs.textualDescription: Write Data Rate over Time

attrs.name: Read Utilization
attrs.textualDescription: Read Utilization

attrs.name: Write Utilization
attrs.textualDescription: Write Utilization

attrs.name: Read Utilization over Time
attrs.textualDescription: Read Utilization over Time

attrs.name: Write Utilization over Time
attrs.textualDescription: Write Utilization over Time

attrs.name: Execution Result Type
attrs.textualDescription: The type of the execution result captures whether an activity finished successfully or not.

attrs.name: Execution Result Type over Time
attrs.textualDescription: The Execution Result Type together with the point in simulation time, the measurement was taken.
